# Clientra

> Open-source client management for freelancers and agencies. Track clients, projects, proposals, and contracts in one place.

Clientra is a self-hostable web application that helps independent professionals and small agencies manage their client workflow end to end — from first conversation to signed contract and renewal.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, pricing, and getting started.
- [Sign In or Sign Up](/auth): Create a Clientra account or log in.

## Optional

- [Client Portal](/portal): Secure, token-gated page where clients review proposals and contracts shared with them. Requires an access link from a Clientra user.
- [Public Portfolio](/portfolio/example): Public-facing project showcase rendered for any Clientra user who has published a portfolio slug.
